description: This Java class 'AttributeReportingConfig' models the configuration for attribute reporting, including properties such as AttributeInfo, min and max reporting intervals, and reportable change. It serves as a data container with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: AttributeReportingConfig
classes.description: A class representing configuration settings for attribute reporting, including interval and change detection parameters.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns the AttributeInfo associated with this reporting configuration.

methods.name: setInfo
methods.description: Sets the AttributeInfo for this reporting configuration.

methods.name: getMinInterval
methods.description: Returns the minimum interval at which reporting occurs.

methods.name: getReportableChange
methods.description: Returns the threshold for reportable change.
